title: Title & Registration Services Terms on Registration, Plates and Delivery of the Title
content:
**(a) Registration issued.** When the state issues registration on a Title & Registration Services order, the order records the registration date and the plate number. For title-only orders no permanent plate number is recorded.

**(b) Mailing.** Plates and the registration card are mailed within the service type's plate mailing business days, and title-only paperwork within its title-only mailing business days.

**(c) The title itself.** When a lienholder is recorded, an electronic-title state holds the title electronically for the lienholder. With no lien, a paper title received from the state is mailed to the owner within the paper title mailing business days.

**(d) Completion.** The order completes when the plates and card, or the title-only paperwork, are delivered.

## The terms as a sequence of order states

| Order status | Event that moves it on | Next status |
|---|---|---|
| submitted | the state issues the title and registration (for title-only, the title) | registered |
| registered | plates and registration card, or title-only paperwork, reach the customer | completed |

## Who holds the title

| Lienholder recorded | Registration state issues electronic titles | Title |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | held electronically for the lienholder |
| no | either | paper title mailed to the owner within the paper title mailing period after it is received from the state |

## Hypothetical illustration

A buyer with no lien whose paper title reaches Kestrel from the state receives it by mail within the paper title mailing period counted in business days from that receipt; the plates and registration card follow their own mailing period counted from the registration date.
